what_happened: At 19:00 UTC the agent running Athena closed its own re-queue of Sri's two planner requests as a duplicate. It did this because the drain log said the originals were "left queued". The originals were not in `athena plan` (status interrupted), so nothing would have run them. The agent then re-queued Sri's two messages verbatim as one high-priority request. No job work was judged.
cause: The agent acts on, or reports about, shared state without resolving what it refers to, and Athena does not guard it. Here the state was whether a held item was still queued. The drain's "left queued" note and the "interrupted" status disagree with `athena plan`, and nothing reconciles them or flags a retry or close of an item whose queue state is unclear. The only guard is the agent's own habit of checking the authoritative view first.
other_causes: The drain log wording 'left queued' is not tied to the plan's actual membership, so it can be false for items marked interrupted.
This is the second miss in one session on the same held items (see 20261113-190052-wwzb), so the first correction did not prevent it.
open_hypotheses: Whether the drain note was wrong, or whether the items were dropped from the plan by a later step, cannot be told from the given fields.
prevention: Add a code check so that `athena status` and the drain's end-of-run note derive each held item's state from the same source as `athena plan`. For each item left held, they should say whether it is in the plan and will run. A retry, close or new ask that names an item or text matching an existing queued or held item should show that item's real plan state and require confirmation before closing a re-queue. No gate counts apply, since no gate was in dispute.
proposed_request: Make athena status and the drain's end-of-run note report, for every item left held or interrupted, whether it is in the athena plan queue and will be run by the next drain, using the same source as athena plan. Outcome: a held item that is not in the plan is shown as not queued, with the command to re-queue it, and a held item that is in the plan is shown as queued. Also make `athena close` and `athena retry` print the target item's plan state before acting, and refuse to close a re-queue as a duplicate of an item that is not in the plan. Acceptance: (1) a test where an item is interrupted and absent from the plan shows 'not queued' in status and in the drain note; (2) a test where an item is held and present in the plan shows 'queued'; (3) a test that closing a re-queue whose apparent original is absent from the plan is refused with a message; (4) CHANGELOG.md entry.
